title: Area-code org enumeration shard A pass 28

data.research_question: Which current or recent public anarchist, anti-authoritarian, autonomous, Food Not Bombs, mutual-aid, collective and closely adjacent organizations are discoverable in shard-A NPAs 816, 828, 831 and 837?
data.method: Deterministic shard-A NPA enumeration from current numbering authority, literal and locality-derived searches, current-status verification, repository dedupe, historical-lead checks, and public organizational communications enumeration.
classification_rules: Use current in-service U.S. NANP geographic NPAs where integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.
Historical directories are discovery seeds and do not establish current activity without fresh corroboration.
Area-code relations represent locality/discovery geography and do not assert telephone-number ownership.
For overlays such as 837, locality within the overlay footprint does not assert that an organization currently uses the new overlay NPA.
Reuse canonical organization identities when already present; do not merge organizations from name or handle similarity alone.
No private membership inference or person-level political/ideological affiliation profiling.

unresolved_leads: Older Kansas City anarchist-directory and affinity-group references require independent current-status corroboration before promotion.
Historical Asheville Food Not Bombs and adjacent post-Helene mutual-aid identities remain unresolved where current organizational continuity could not be cleanly established.
Additional Santa Cruz radical-event co-sponsors remain queued for ordinary organization-network expansion rather than being identity-merged from event proximity.
North Valley Mutual Aid has historical evidence but insufficient current 2026 continuity evidence.
Chico Food Not Bombs surfaced in historical/local-directory material but current status was not sufficiently established.

coverage.shard_rule: current in-service U.S. geographic NPA and integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0
